title: Insights snapshot carousel — usability review, redlines & accessibility pass
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Overview: This ticket tracks the design review cycle for the new 'Insights Snapshot' carousel: a compact, horizontally-scrollable widget that surfaces recent rollout and cost snapshots on the Console dashboard. Goal is to reduce vertical real-estate while keeping glanceability and keyboard accessibility.

Work completed so far: low-fidelity flows -> mid-fidelity carousel prototype in Figma -> moderated usability test with 6 internal participants -> visual polish pass for dark/light themes -> preliminary redlines for dev handoff. Prototype supports keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, and reduced-motion state.

Scope for this ticket: capture stakeholder feedback, consolidate redlines, ensure accessibility fixes from usability session, and prepare final handoff artifact for Engineering + QA. This is a design-review and handoff ticket, not the engineering implementation task.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes working keyboard focus states and ARIA labels
Contrast and color tokens match Console theme tokens (light + dark)
Performance concerns (animation cost) documented and a reduced-motion alternative provided
Developer redlines (SVG exports, CSS spacing tokens, breakpoints) uploaded to Confluence and linked
Stakeholder sign-off from PM and Eng lead recorded in comments
decisions_made: Switch default behavior to 'snap-to-card' rather than free scroll to improve discoverability
For narrow viewports (<720px) use stacked vertical cards instead of horizontal carousel to reduce keyboard traversal
Provide a reduced-motion preference that disables parallax/auto-scroll and uses instant transitions
Use existing cost tile component tokens (spacing & typography) to minimize divergence from dashboard
open_questions: Telemetry: which interactions should emit events (card expand, CTA click, swipe vs keyboard)? PM to confirm event list
Rollout linking: should the snapshot deep-link directly to rollout-inspection or to the rollout timeline summary?
A/B test plan: what metric will be primary (time-to-first-action vs. CTA click-through)?
Edge case: how do we prioritize content when more than 5 snapshots exist? Current proposal curates by recency and severity
comments: 2026-03-02 - Priya Rao (PM): Love the compact approach; request to ensure the primary CTA is always visible without an extra keystroke. Asked for event list for analytics.

2026-03-04 - Omar Singh (Eng lead): Flagged potential perf cost of continuous horizontal parallax on older GPUs. Requested a reduced-motion mode and explicit animation budget guidance for CSS/JS fallback.
2026-03-06 - Ana Morales (Design QA): Noted low contrast on the subtle tag label in dark theme at 12px; recommends increasing weight or swapping to primary token.

2026-03-08 - Liam O'Connor (assignee): Updated prototype to add snap-to-card behavior, keyboard traps prevention, and added aria-live region for dynamic updates. Uploaded preliminary redlines to Confluence.
2026-03-09 - Stakeholder review (sync): PM + Eng + Design reviewed prototype; action items captured below. PM gave provisional sign-off pending analytics event list and A/B metric definition.
next_steps: Finalize analytics event list with PM (blocked until response from Priya) — target date 2026-03-12
Prepare dev handoff package (SVGs, CSS token map, breakpoints) and attach to ENG-20345 as dependency
Add reduced-motion CSS classes and example implementation in code sample for eng (provide snippet in Confluence)
Schedule 30m dev handoff meeting and run through redlines + QA checklist (invite: UX, PM, Eng lead, QA)
